segments.source: save(to:ofType:for:delegate:didSave:contextInfo:)
segments.ko: save(to:ofType:for:delegate:didSave:contextInfo:)

segments.source: **Framework**: AppKit **Kind**: method
segments.ko: **Framework**: AppKit **Kind**: method

segments.source: Saves the contents of the document to a file or file package located by a URL, that is formatted to a specified type, for a particular kind of save operation.
segments.ko: Saves the contents of the document to a file or file package located by a URL, that is formatted to a specified type, for a particular kind of save operation.

segments.ko: **Availability**:

segments.source: macOS ?+
segments.ko: macOS ?+

segments.source: Declaration
segments.ko: Declaration

segments.source: Discussion
segments.ko: Discussion

segments.source: When saving is completed, regardless of success or failure, the method sends the message selected by `didSaveSelector` to the `delegate`, with the `contextInfo` as the last argument.
segments.ko: When saving is completed, regardless of success or failure, the method sends the message selected by `didSaveSelector` to the `delegate`, with the `contextInfo` as the last argument.

segments.source: The method selected by `didSaveSelector` must have the same signature as:
segments.ko: The method selected by `didSaveSelector` must have the same signature as:

segments.source: The default implementation of this method invokes `[self saveToURL:absoluteURL ofType:typeName forSaveOperation:saveOperation error:&anError]` and, if [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false) is returned, presents the error to the user in a document-modal panel before messaging the delegate.
segments.ko: The default implementation of this method invokes `[self saveToURL:absoluteURL ofType:typeName forSaveOperation:saveOperation error:&anError]` and, if [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false) is returned, presents the error to the user in a document-modal panel before messaging the delegate.

segments.source: Parameters
segments.ko: Parameters

segments.source: `url`: The location of the file or file package to which the document contents are saved.
segments.ko: `url`: The location of the file or file package to which the document contents are saved.

segments.source: `typeName`: The string that identifies the document type.
segments.ko: `typeName`: The string that identifies the document type.

segments.source: `saveOperation`: The type of save operation.
segments.ko: `saveOperation`: The type of save operation.

segments.source: `delegate`: The delegate to which the selector message is sent.
segments.ko: `delegate`: The delegate to which the selector message is sent.

segments.source: `didSaveSelector`: The selector of the message sent to the delegate.
segments.ko: `didSaveSelector`: The selector of the message sent to the delegate.

segments.source: `contextInfo`: Object passed with the callback to provide any additional context information.
segments.ko: `contextInfo`: Object passed with the callback to provide any additional context information.
